sentence: The deployable dual-mode path remains ahead of single-mode Wiener, and the archived kernels have already been timed on an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, including sub-millisecond medians at the small sizes. The same card's average-pool comparison is the open race: the current operator finished first, so the broad speed and thermal claim stays unmet until a later same-GPU row reverses it.
